description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
New in the Original Packaging
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Level 1 Brake Rebuild Kit
This Rebuild Kit was designed for people whose rear brake cylinders and Lever Assemblies are in good shape and don’t need replacing. So if your good on those then this rebuild kit will give you everything you need to rebuild the front and rear brakes on your Sammy at the lowest possible price.
Note: If you want a Rebuild Kit that includes the Rear Brake Cylinders and Lever Assemblies for both sides then purchase our Complete Brake Rebuild Kit.
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Front Brakes:
Qty 2 – Front Calipers
Qty 2 – Brake Pads (LH & RH Sides)
Qty 2 – Bleeder Plugs w/ Caps for Calipers
Rear Brakes:
Qty 4 – Brake Shoes
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Drum Repair Kit:
Qty 4 – Shoe Hold-down Pins
Qty 2 – Hold-down Springs
Qty 1 – Spring Rod – Left
Qty 1 – Spring Rod – Right
Qty 2 – Shoe Return Springs – Short
Qty 2 – Shoe Return Springs – Long
Qty 2 – Bleeder Valves
Qty 2 – Lever Seals
Qty 2 – Lever Seal Clips
Qty 2 – Lever Stopper
Qty 4 – Bolts & Lock Washer’s
Qty 2 – Cup & Boot Repair Kit
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995
